gameDescriptionHtml:
HYPERVIOLENT is a brutal, old-school FPS in the style of classic sprite-based 3D games from the 1990s – but think more System Shock, less DOOM. After responding to a distress signal from Commodus Asteroid 27-C, a remote mining colony, you find yourself in the midst of an outbreak of violence among its inhabitants. You must unravel the secrets of the asteroid and the evil hidden deep within its mines as you seek an answer to the madness within its complex corridors.

What led the I.E.C. Commodus to descend into chaos? Collect data-logs and notes left behind by its ill-fated crew, piece together the dark story behind the outpost’s downfall, and navigate your way to the lowest levels deep within the asteroid to uncover the sinister conspiracy festering beneath. Unlock doors with keycards, retrieve access codes for terminals, and find solutions to overcome the hazards and obstacles in your path.

Obliterate your foes with an extensive array of guns and melee weapons that can be dual-wielded in nearly endless combinations, and take the VIOLENCE to the next level. You are far from an invincible action hero however – manage your resources carefully, and be ever vigilant, for enemies can ambush you when you least expect it.

Game Features

  • Gorgeous 3D / Pixel Hybrid – Explore 14 detailed areas of the I.E.C. Commodus station and paint them with viscera, all rendered in a combination of classic low-poly 3D, hand-crafted pixel art, and uniquely rich lighting.
  • Intense horror atmosphere – Feel the dread of exploring the dark entrails of a recently operational but now dead asteroid station, light-years from rescue. Something has gone wrong – but no one is left to explain. No backup. No signal. Just you, the darkness, and whatever still moves in it.
  • Brutal combat – Brandish 22 unique ranged and melee weapons in dozens of dual-wield combinations to obliterate the monstrous denizens of Commodus! But don’t get cocky – manage your resources, salvage spare armaments for parts, and repair your gear. You don’t want to be caught empty-handed in a bossfight.
  • RPG / FPS mechanics – Manage your inventory, upgrade weapons, & peruse through computer data logs to further your mission in this exciting, authentically nostalgic experience.
  • Use the environment to your advantage – Operate switches, terminals, and keycard systems to unlock paths, disable hazards, and progress through the station’s sprawling corridors.
  • Six Degrees of Violence – Employ numerous methods of dispatching your enemies, commandeer heavy-duty mine equipment, and even fly a fully functional spacecraft in nostalgic Six Degrees of Freedom combat.
